items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: And then he went with Tommy and then I went with Shorty Sherock.

ctx.x: ’38, yeah. And in fact he did the Old Gold Show from CBS with Artie Shaw. And Robert Benchley was the host. And I’d stand there, it was like a seven o’clock or six o’clock broadcast And Robert Benchley was the host and they’d open up with, they’d say, “would somebody wake up Benchley? Would somebody wake up Benchley? Would somebody, somebody, somebody, somebody, somebody, wake up Benchley? And he’d say, “ahhh, he’s up.” And Buddy’d play a drum fill and they played “Crazy Rhythm.” And I used to wait that whole…

“excuse me Mr. Shaw,” I said, and he felt like talking, I don’t know. He said, “what is it, young man?” I said, “well I read that you were looking for a drummer.” Cliff Lehman was leaving. I said, “I know the greatest.” And he said, “who is that?” And I said, “Buddy Rich.” And he said, “he can’t play.” And a week later he joined the band. And in my little mind there I thought I got him the job. And then he went with Tommy and then I went with Shorty Sherock. That was the first band I really played — the first…
Which band was this now? Shorty Sherock?
